source: LTCFocus, Brown University School of Public Health (ltcfocus.org)

sources.insp: Inspection records (CASPER): reported by the home at its annual inspection by RIDOH for CMS.
sources.mds: Resident assessments (MDS): residents in the home on the first Thursday in April.
sources.adm: Resident assessments (MDS) of everyone admitted during the year.
sources.pay: Payroll records (PBJ): the week with the first Thursday in April, except where noted.
sources.qm: CMS quality measures (Care Compare), April to June.
sources.mcr: Medicare and enrollment records (LTCFocus's Residential History File).
sources.out: Resident assessments (MDS) for the whole year, linked by LTCFocus to hospital records.

measures.label: Beds
measures.def: Certified beds, as reported at the home's annual inspection.

measures.label: Residents on the first Thursday in April
measures.def: Number of residents in the home that day.

measures.label: Average daily census
measures.def: Average number of residents in the home each day of the year.

measures.label: Occupancy (%)
measures.def: Occupied beds as a share of all beds, at the home's annual inspection.

measures.label: For-profit
measures.def: Whether the home is run for profit. For a group of homes, the share of homes.

measures.label: Part of a chain
measures.def: Whether the home is part of a chain. For a group of homes, the share of homes.

measures.label: Hospital-based
measures.def: Whether the home is part of a hospital. For a group of homes, the share of homes.

measures.label: Has a dementia (Alzheimer's) unit
measures.def: Whether the home reports a special care unit for dementia. For a group of homes, the share of homes.

measures.label: Has any special care unit
measures.def: Whether the home reports any special care unit, not counting ventilator units. For a group of homes, the share of homes.

measures.label: Medicaid main payer (% of residents)
measures.def: Residents whose care is paid mainly by Medicaid, at the home's annual inspection.

measures.label: Medicare main payer (% of residents)
measures.def: Residents whose care is paid mainly by Medicare, at the home's annual inspection.

measures.label: Medicare Advantage (% of residents)
measures.def: Residents in a Medicare Advantage plan on the first Thursday in April.

measures.label: Private pay (% of resident days)
measures.def: Share of the year's resident days that were private pay, from LTCFocus's Medicare and enrollment records. LTCFocus published this only for 2000 to 2015.

measures.label: Average age
measures.def: Average age of residents.

measures.label: Under 65 (%)
measures.def: Residents younger than 65.

measures.label: Women (%)
measures.def: Residents who are women.

measures.label: White (%)
measures.def: Residents recorded as White.

measures.label: Black (%)
measures.def: Residents recorded as Black.

measures.label: Hispanic (%)
measures.def: Residents recorded as Hispanic.

measures.label: Acuity index
measures.def: How much care the residents need, from counts the home reports at its inspection: help with daily activities and special treatments. Higher means more care.

measures.label: ADL score (0 to 28)
measures.def: How much help residents need with daily activities like eating, moving, and using the toilet. 0 means no help, 28 means total help.

measures.label: Low-care residents (%), 2011 to 2019
measures.def: Residents who need little help with daily activities. LTCFocus changed how it counts this in 2020.

measures.label: Low-care residents (%), 2020 on
measures.def: Residents who need little help with daily activities, counted LTCFocus's newer way.

measures.label: Bedfast (%)
measures.def: Residents who stay in bed all or most of the time.

measures.label: Walk in the hallway (%)
measures.def: Residents who can walk in the hallway.

measures.label: Bladder incontinence (%)
measures.def: Residents who are incontinent of urine.

measures.label: Bowel incontinence (%)
measures.def: Residents who are incontinent of bowel.

measures.label: Catheter (%)
measures.def: Residents with a urinary catheter.

measures.label: On a ventilator (%)
measures.def: Residents on a ventilator.

measures.label: Alzheimer's or other dementia (%)
measures.def: Residents with Alzheimer's disease or another dementia.

measures.label: Little or no memory and thinking problems (%)
measures.def: Residents whose cognition is intact or only a little impaired.

measures.label: Moderate memory and thinking problems (%)
measures.def: Residents with mild or moderate cognitive impairment.

measures.label: Severe memory and thinking problems (%)
measures.def: Residents with severe cognitive impairment.

measures.label: Schizophrenia or bipolar disorder (%)
measures.def: Residents with schizophrenia or bipolar disorder.

measures.label: Heart failure (%)
measures.def: Residents with congestive heart failure.

measures.label: High blood pressure (%)
measures.def: Residents with high blood pressure.

measures.label: Severe obesity (%)
measures.def: Residents with a body mass index of 35 or more.

measures.label: Urinary tract infection (%)
measures.def: Residents with a urinary tract infection.

measures.label: Admissions per bed
measures.def: Admissions during the year divided by the number of beds. Higher means more short stays.

measures.label: Admitted from a hospital (%)
measures.def: Share of the year's admissions that came from a hospital.

measures.label: Admitted from the community (%)
measures.def: Share of the year's admissions that came from home or elsewhere in the community.

measures.label: Nurse staff hours per resident day, 2011 to 2018
measures.def: Hours of RNs, LPNs, and nurse aides per resident per day, from the home's staffing report at its inspection.

measures.label: RN hours per resident day, 2011 to 2018
measures.def: Registered nurse hours per resident per day, from the home's staffing report at its inspection.

measures.label: LPN hours per resident day, 2011 to 2018
measures.def: Licensed practical nurse hours per resident per day, from the home's staffing report at its inspection.

measures.label: Aide hours per resident day, 2011 to 2018
measures.def: Nurse aide hours per resident per day, from the home's staffing report at its inspection.

measures.label: RN share of licensed nurses (%), 2011 to 2018
measures.def: RNs as a share of all RNs and LPNs, from the home's staffing report at its inspection.

measures.label: Nurse practitioner or physician assistant, 2011 to 2018
measures.def: Whether the home reported a nurse practitioner or physician assistant at its inspection. For a group of homes, the share of homes.

measures.label: Nurse staff hours per resident day, payroll, 2017 on
measures.def: Paid hours of RNs, LPNs, and nurse aides per resident per weekday.

measures.label: RN hours per resident day, payroll, 2017 on
measures.def: Paid registered nurse hours per resident per weekday.

measures.label: LPN hours per resident day, payroll, 2017 on
measures.def: Paid licensed practical nurse hours per resident per weekday.

measures.label: Aide hours per resident day, payroll, 2017 on
measures.def: Paid nurse aide hours per resident per weekday.

measures.label: RN share of licensed nurse hours (%), payroll, 2017 on
measures.def: RN hours as a share of RN and LPN hours.

measures.label: Nurse practitioner or physician assistant on payroll, 2019 on
measures.def: Whether the home paid a nurse practitioner or physician assistant at any time in the year. For a group of homes, the share of homes.

measures.label: Physically restrained (%)
measures.def: Residents physically restrained, as reported at the home's annual inspection.

measures.label: Fell since admission or last assessment (%)
measures.def: Residents who had a fall since they arrived or since their last assessment.

measures.label: Pressure ulcers, high-risk long-stay residents (%)
measures.def: Long-stay residents at high risk who have pressure ulcers (bed sores).

measures.label: Long-stay residents needing more help with daily activities (%)
measures.def: Long-stay residents whose need for help with daily activities went up.

measures.label: Long-stay residents with daily pain (%), 2011 to 2018
measures.def: Long-stay residents with moderate to severe pain.

measures.label: Flu shot given in this home (%)
measures.def: Residents who got a flu shot in this home.

measures.label: Flu shot, here or elsewhere (%)
measures.def: Residents who got a flu shot in this home or somewhere else.

measures.label: Hospital stays per resident year
measures.def: Hospital stays for every 365 days residents spent in the home. Not adjusted for how sick residents were.

measures.label: Rehospitalization rate (%)
measures.def: Residents newly admitted from a hospital who went back to a hospital (LTCFocus's rehospitalization rate). Not adjusted.

measures.label: Rehospitalization rate, adjusted (%)
measures.def: The same figure, adjusted by LTCFocus for how sick residents were when they arrived.

measures.label: Successful discharge to the community (%)
measures.def: Residents newly admitted from a hospital who went home or elsewhere in the community within 100 days and had no nursing home stay in the 30 days after. Not adjusted.

measures.label: Successful discharge to the community, adjusted (%)
measures.def: The same figure, adjusted by LTCFocus for how sick residents were when they arrived.
